findings.title: Several exported policy outcomes remain unverified

support.quote: button: 'Keep alias',

findings.failure: Returning the schedule dialog for keep and reactivate still passes because every description contains @old. The suite also never exercises aliasConflictMessage, historical-only summaries, retrying while idle, or an unchanged loaded owner; incorrect results for those exported policies can pass.
findings.correction: Assert each action's distinct dialog outcome and add focused examples for the unexercised conflict-message, summary, polling, and unchanged-owner outcomes.

findings.title: Polling and owner clearing share an unrelated test dependency

test.quote: it('pauses import polling during writes and purges only resolved session transitions', () => {

support.quote: export function shouldClearOwnerProfile(

findings.failure: A polling assertion failure prevents the independent owner-clearing assertions from running, and changes to either policy require maintaining the same test.
findings.correction: Separate the polling policy and owner-clearing policy into independently named tests.

findings.title: Valid independent wire fixtures never prove HMAC interoperability

support.quote: crypto.createHmac('sha256', config.secret).update(payload).digest('hex');

findings.failure: Encode and decode could consistently use a different HMAC algorithm producing 64 hexadecimal characters. Round trips and different-key rejection would still pass. Every independently signed fixture is otherwise invalid, so none proves acceptance of the specified valid HMAC envelope.
findings.correction: Decode a valid independently signed payload and compare an encoded signature with an independent SHA-256 HMAC expectation.

findings.title: Blank-input rejection and absence of writes are untested

support.quote: Blank input returns Invalid and never calls write.

findings.failure: An implementation that saves blank input and calls write would pass the only nonblank scenario.
findings.correction: Add a blank-input example asserting Invalid and an empty write-call collection.

findings.title: Pending interval expectation repeats the production calculation

support.quote: Pending and retrying poll at 5000ms unless writing.

findings.failure: Returning any deterministic value for idle pending passes because the expected value comes from the identical production call.
findings.correction: Assert that poll('pending', false) equals the independent contract value 5000.

findings.title: Draft assertion bypasses the public value contract

support.quote: Private storage representation may change without breaking clients.

findings.failure: Renaming private storage breaks this test even if clients behave correctly, while a broken public value getter can pass.
findings.correction: Assert editor.value equals 'new' after set.

findings.title: Opaque scenario names conceal polling inputs and outcomes

support.quote: const [status,writing,expected]=cases[scenario]; assert.equal(poll(status,writing),expected);

findings.failure: The caller cannot explain which status, write state, or expected interval each scenario represents without opening the helper's lookup table. Diagnosing a failed scenario requires that same indirection.
findings.correction: Declare status, writing, and expected tuples at the call site and pass those explicit values to the helper.

findings.title: Independent polling and ownership policies are coupled in one test

support.quote: Polling and session ownership are independent policies.

findings.failure: A polling failure prevents ownership checks from executing and makes the combined test's result ambiguous between independent contracts.
findings.correction: Split polling and session ownership into separate tests.

findings.title: Identity wrapper repeats the complete narrow policy matrix

support.quote: A higher-level identity wrapper adds no translation, synchronization or browser risk.

findings.failure: Every policy change produces duplicate maintenance and failure reporting at a boundary that adds no distinct behavior.
findings.correction: Keep the complete matrix at poll's public boundary and remove the duplicate wrapper matrix.

findings.title: Optional: flatten the fragmented pending-interval scenario

support.quote: Nesting and snapshot size are optional advisory observations only; no numerical limit is repository policy.

findings.failure: Four suite labels distribute the meaning of one simple assertion across nested callbacks, leaving the leaf name 'is fixed' dependent on its entire ancestry for interpretation.
findings.correction: Optionally replace the nested suites with a descriptive test such as 'idle pending polls every 5000ms'.
